title: chore(cli)!: 18.x restore of the 18.0 guards — re-open the upgrade ceremony and walled boots
body:
**⛔ BLOCKED — 18.x only.** This card undoes the 18.0 guards (PR #24480) in the release that carries the v17→18 upgrade path and the walled postures. It does not start before then.

Blocked-by: #15212

Part of #15194 (ADR-0131). Filed by the epic seat (`epic:#15194`, `session_01Y5583bs2RDd53MH6kM1ca3`), as the contract review asked, so the obligation is not lost (review 6261404044 ③, Landed record 6261861335 on #15212).

**Why.** 18.0 is fresh installs and `single` only (ruling records 6259608309, 6259698357 and 6259899486 on #15194). #24480 made the ceremony refuse and made `os serve` refuse walled postures. When 18.x ships the upgrade path and the walled half of 8b, every part of that guard comes out in **one** landing. A half restore would leave the e2e coverage off while the walls are live.

**The restore list** (line numbers at merge commit `ae6bd1a69`; re-measure):
1. Delete the refusing subclass `MigrateOrganizationOwnership` (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/organization-ownership.ts:1095-1146`). Re-add `default` to `OrganizationOwnershipCeremony` (`:319`).
2. Delete the `walledPostureRefusal` call and the function (`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:2411-2423`, `:6255-6285`), with its test `serve-walled-posture-refusal.test.ts` and the ceremony's `organization-ownership.release-refusal.test.ts`.
3. Restore the seven e2e cases of `packages/cli/test/serve-organizations-host-resolution.e2e.test.ts` and `serve-organizations-mount-failure.e2e.test.ts`. Take them from the parent of #24480's squash commit, in the same landing.
4. Put dogfood step 2 (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/organization-ownership-boot-refusal-order.dogfood.test.ts`) back on the binary, and drop step 2a.
5. Remove the six 18.0 docs sentences: `cli.mdx` (three sites), `environment-variables.mdx:101`, `self-hosting.mdx:469-470` and `tenancy-modes.mdx:19-22`. Also remove C11's (#15214) 18.0 riders if they have landed by then: the boot-guard one-liner, `TENANCY_POSTURE_FIX_HINTS` and the `os doctor` sentence.
6. Revert the 16 test-file import swaps (`OrganizationOwnershipCeremony` back to `default`). This is optional; they are byte-identical in behaviour.

**Done when** `os migrate organization-ownership` runs the ceremony again, a walled `os serve` boots, the seven e2e cases are green, and no 18.0 sentence remains.
